events.title: Salty is in Steam Next Fest — play the free demo!
events.summary: It starts at one cell...Salty: Evolution Simulator is part of Steam Next Fest, October 19–26 — and the free demo is ready to play right now. What's in the demoSwim a living microbial ocean where every creature is modeled on a real organismHunt and engulf prey, collect DNA and craft your first organelles — cilia, flagella, tentacles and more Explore reefs and a pitch-dark cave full of glowing jellies Learn real cell biology through short narrated lessons — or switch them off and just survive Play

events.title: Grab Anything: Salty Demo v0.9.97
events.summary: The most requested change from our testers is in: the tentacle grapple no longer fires in the direction you happen to be swimming. You aim it yourself, you can grab almost anything in the water, and you can drag what you catch somewhere safer before you eat it. This build (live as v0.9.971) also rounds up a week of controller, Mac and Steam Deck fixes that shipped since our last post. Aim, grab, dragAim independently of swimming. events.title: Sounds of the Cave — Salty Demo v0.9.95
events.summary: A build for your earsThis update is mostly about how the demo sounds and how it treats you when things go wrong. Nearly every placeholder tone from the early builds has been replaced, the dark cave now has real acoustics, crafting your first Nucleus Pore has its own lesson, dying deep in the reef no longer drags you all the way back to the start, and the tentacles are a proper weapon against the virus swarm. events.title: The Water Is Alive — Salty Demo v0.9.94
events.summary: The water is now full of living bacteria that scatter, regroup and get eaten in front of you. Your cell has a real nucleus and real DNA inside it. And a new game no longer just drops you in: you watch your cell form. Living bacteria:Four species, hundreds of cells. Purple Staph clusters, green E. coli rods, yellow Strep bead chains and orange Pseudomonas. events.title: The Cave Bites Back — Salty Demo v0.9.91
events.summary: A real route through the darkThe demo just updated to v0.9.91, and it is the biggest change since the demo went live. The dark jelly cave west of the reef is no longer a dead end you can poke your nose into and leave. It is now the way forward, it commits you, and it has its own music, its own creatures and its own voice. The dark cave route]A current guards the mouth. events.title: Sound Effects Day, complete audio pass, and viruses are back, Salty Demo v0.9.8

AudioAmbient water bed. Two long underwater recordings alternate beneath the music, crossfading so you never hear a seam. With the music style set to None you still hear the ocean. events.title: Full Controller Support & Steam Deck — Salty Demo v0.9.3
events.summary: Salty now plays fully on a controller — and it's ready for the Steam DeckThe demo just updated to v0.9.3. Left stick to swim (analog — half tilt is a gentle drift, full tilt is a sprint), RT to engulf, LT for the endotoxin burst, A to dash, X stun, B whip, Y grapple, LB divide, RB skill tree, Back for crafting, Start to pause. events.title: Demo Update — reworked creatures, all-new lighting, and 8 new languages

events.title: The Salty Demo is OUT NOW — free on Steam
events.summary: You're one cell, in a new world. The free demo for Salty: Evolution Simulator is live — download it right now from the store page and start your climb up the food chain. And yes, we're part of the PvE Survival Crafting Fest through Sep 7, so if you're browsing the fest, welcome.
